remarks: **10/18**Back on the Market!**If You Missed Out On This Great House, Here is Your Second Chance!** Location!! Location!!**Light & Bright EAST NORWALK Gem!! Walk to the Beach!! Character Abounds with This Lovingly Updated and Maintained 1900's Quaint Colonial. Foyer, Spacious Living Room & Formal Dining Room ALL with Hardwood Floors, Crown Moulding and Recessed Lighting. Beautifully Updated Kitchen (2024). New Cabinets, Quartz Counters, SS Appliances, and Chef's DACOR@ Gas Stove for The Cook. Full Bathroom Off the Kitchen with Tub, Tile & Wainscotting. 3 Bedrooms upstairs with Hardwood Floors, Recessed Lighting. 2nd Full Bath w/Tile Shower. Walk Up Attic. Central Air. Enclosed 3 Season Front Porch to Relax and Watch the World Go By. Full Dry Basement. Central Air. New Economical Gas Furnace. House Painted 2025. New Trex Stairs. 4 Years Old Roof. Detached Garage. Off Street Parking. Large Yard for Entertaining and Room for your Vegetable Garden! All Surrounded by a White Picket Fence. No Flood Insurance Required! Easy Commute by Road or Rail. WALK to the TRAIN. Less than 1 Hour from NYC. WALK to the Beaches, Boating, Tennis, Concerts, Mini Golf, Festivals, Dog Park, Playground, Restaurants, SONO, Nightlife, and More! Enjoy All that Norwalk Has to Offer!
